name: Hinokage (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hinokage town emblem in white: a ring crossed by horizontal bars, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hinokage, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 December 1955.

features.role: Hinokage town emblem — a ring crossed by horizontal bars, like a stylised character
